shapeSummary: Flat circular 127 mm diameter, 3 mm thick plate. Its bottom face is at Y=0 and the thickness runs along +Y. Cut into it are two large rectangular windows, two small rectangular cutouts, four slots and two mid-size round holes. The pattern is approximated from the photo for the Tamiya gearbox, ball caster and hardware.
warnings: The 127 mm diameter comes from the listing and is unverified.
The 3 mm thickness is a placeholder because no thickness is given.
Cutout positions and sizes were estimated from the photo, assuming a scale of about 0.338 mm/px with the plate diameter at 127 mm. They are approximate.
The many small round mounting holes and the smaller slots around the edge were omitted because their sizes and positions are uncertain.
Several cutouts are partly hidden by the hand in the photo, so their shapes are estimated.
The Pololu watermark was not modeled.
